title: myroxylon longifolium
intro: Myroxylon longifolium, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a plant species native to South America. The health benefits of Palo Santo include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, alleviate pain, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its aromatic properties and medicinal effects.
